verified_facts.text: The Tropicale restaurant and bar is housed in the original landmarked Sundial restaurant and bar, now restored.

verified_facts.text: The Matador Room is the signature restaurant, with a 1940s supper club-like atmosphere and cuisine inspired by South America, the Caribbean and Spain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring a supper club-like atmosphere reminiscent of the 1940s, the Matador Room tempts guests with innovative cuisine inspired by the flavors of South America, the Caribbean, and Spain.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a four-lane bowling alley, Basement Bowl, with color-changing lighting effects.
verified_facts.excerpt: Basement Bowl is a four-lane bowling alley with visually spectacular lighting effects of dramatic, color-changing illuminations.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a 2,000 square-foot indoor ice skating rink.
verified_facts.excerpt: One of the most intriguing features at The Miami Beach EDITION is the 2,000 square-foot indoor ice skating rink.

verified_facts.text: Basement Bowl and Basement Skate enforce a 21+ rule after 9PM.
The Lobby Bar has original gold and marble columns and a 1950s Miami Beach feel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The glamour of 1950s Miami Beach can be found in every detail of the Lobby Bar, from the original gold and marble columns to the Latin-inspired soundtrack.

verified_facts.text: Market at EDITION is a food hall-inspired restaurant with a dining room overlooking Collins Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: Market at EDITION, a food hall-inspired restaurant in the heart of Miami Beach.

verified_facts.text: The hotel includes bungalows, and top-level bungalows have a roof deck with a private plunge pool.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are pet-friendly, with marble bathrooms and enclosed rainforest showers.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has two outdoor ocean-facing pools.
